description: Coverage measurements over time for a single flag, bucketed by interval. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/flags/{flag_name}/coverage/.

branch.description: Branch to measure (defaults to the default branch).

endDate.description: End of the range, yyyy-mm-dd (maps to `end_date`).

interval.description: Aggregation interval for the trend — '1d', '7d' or '30d'.

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (maps to `page_size`).

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

startDate.description: Start of the range, yyyy-mm-dd (maps to `start_date`).

name: codecov_get_flag_coverage_trend
title: Get flag coverage trend
